description: Update axios from 0.27.2 to 1.6.0+ to fix CVE-2024-XXXXX and migrate breaking changes. Workspace: /home/ga/workspace/api-project. Steps: (1) Read MIGRATION_GUIDE.md to understand changes, (2) Update package.json to set axios to ^1.6.0, (3) Run 'npm install' in terminal to install new version, (4) In lib/payment-client.js replace all 'error.request' checks with 'error.code === "ERR_NETWORK"' pattern, (5) In middleware/api-client.js replace 'error.request' checks with 'error.code === "ERR_NETWORK"' pattern, (6) Keep error.response handling unchanged, (7) Save all files. The migration guide explains that axios 1.x changed network error detection from checking error.request to checking error.code === 'ERR_NETWORK'.
